issue.standard_remedy: Consolidate tail suppliers into preferred suppliers
issue.summary: 139 of 168 suppliers share the last 20% of category spend

plan.diagnosis: The Bearings category exhibits severe supplier fragmentation with 139 suppliers accounting for only 20% of spend (USD 1,411,111), while the HHI of 855 indicates highly dispersed purchasing power. This tail of 82.7% of suppliers (139 of 168) creates excessive transactional overhead, reduces negotiating leverage, and increases compliance risk across five ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Coupa).

remedy_steps.step: Conduct spend analysis to identify the 139 tail suppliers across all five ERPs and map their commodities to the existing offerings of Windsor Precision Components KG (current 18.9% share) and 2-3 other strategic suppliers capable of absorbing tail volume
Issue RFQ to Windsor Precision Components KG and shortlisted strategic suppliers for the USD 1,411,111 tail spend, targeting 12-15% volume discount and standardized payment terms (Net 60)
Award contracts to 3-5 preferred suppliers, negotiate master service agreements with consolidated pricing, and communicate phase-out plan to the 139 tail suppliers with 60-day transition notice

Implement ERP controls: block 139 tail suppliers for new POs across all systems, create approved source lists limited to preferred suppliers, and establish catalog punch-outs in Coupa for guided buying
Transition tail spend purchase orders to preferred suppliers, validate quality and delivery performance for 90 days, and conduct supplier business reviews with preferred partners

plan.expected_impact: Consolidation of USD 1,411,111 tail spend into 3-5 preferred suppliers is expected to yield 12-15% savings (USD 169,333 to USD 211,667 annually) plus reduction of 139 supplier relationships reducing administrative costs by approximately USD 50,000 annually.
kpis: Number of active Bearings suppliers reduced from 168 to 29 or fewer
HHI index increase from 855 to above 1,500 indicating improved concentration
Tail spend (bottom 20%) reduced from USD 1,411,111 to under USD 350,000
Cost savings achieved as percentage of tail spend (target: 12-15% or USD 169,333-211,667)
PO transaction count reduction (target: 60% fewer POs for tail spend)
Supplier onboarding/maintenance cost reduction (139 fewer active vendors)
risks: Supply continuity risk if preferred suppliers cannot fulfill specialized bearing requirements currently met by niche tail suppliers
Quality degradation if consolidation forces specification changes or substitution of non-equivalent bearing types
Delivery delays during 60-day transition period as preferred suppliers ramp up capacity for new part numbers
Resistance from business units with established relationships with tail suppliers, requiring change management
Data migration errors across five ERP systems during supplier blocking and source list updates causing requisition failures
Preferred suppliers may lack capacity to absorb full USD 1,411,111 volume, limiting consolidation scope
erp_actions: SAP: Set posting block in LFA1 (centrally) and ordering block in LFB1 (per company code) for 139 tail suppliers; create source lists (ME01) restricting Bearings material group to 3-5 preferred suppliers with validity dates

Oracle EBS: Set supplier sites to 'Inactive' status for 139 tail vendors; update approved supplier list (ASL) for Bearings category items to include only preferred suppliers; configure sourcing rules to enforce preferred supplier selection

Dynamics 365: Change vendor account status to 'On hold' for tail suppliers; create and publish restricted products list associating Bearings procurement category with preferred vendor trade agreements
NetSuite: Inactivate 139 tail vendor records; build saved searches to flag requisitions for Bearings with non-preferred suppliers; update item records to set preferred vendors in sourcing tab

Coupa: Remove 139 tail suppliers from Bearings category forms; configure approval rules requiring VP approval for non-catalog Bearings purchases; enable punchout catalogs for preferred suppliers with negotiated pricing
